acceptanceCriteria: Owner records a decision: keep owner-only readmission, or accept a bounded dispatcher readmission requirement with its own spec amendment and tests.
body: Issue https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/431 asks the continuous dispatcher to heal by readmitting RETRY_EXHAUSTED tickets. CAL-V0-043 makes `ticket reopen` of an exhausted OPEN ticket an explicit OWNER invocation with a reason. The S11 dispatcher (CAL-V0-048..054, branch claude/tasks-continuous-dispatch) therefore only emits a `needs-owner` event naming `ticket reopen` and never readmits. Owner decision needed: keep owner-only readmission, or authorize a bounded dispatcher readmission policy (e.g. per-ticket cap, reason template, owner-signed config) as a new requirement.
title: Question: may the issue-431 dispatcher readmit RETRY_EXHAUSTED tickets, or does readmission stay owner-only (CAL-V0-043)?
